one_liner: Paygent (gopaygent.com, NMI-style gateway) offers a REST payments API with bearer API keys and a free sandbox. Live use needs a paid gateway plan, and the evidence mixes several unrelated "Paygent" products.
access_notes: The sandbox has full API access at no cost with no credit card. Production uses a $15/mo gateway plus $0.10 per transaction. Merchant underwriting may also apply (not confirmed).
blocker_notes: Sandbox is free, but live processing needs a paid gateway account. The search results cover several different "Paygent" products (paygent.to, withpaygent.com, paygent.tech, Japan's Paygent), so mapping to the intended "Paygent Connect" is uncertain. No full API reference was seen for gopaygent.com.

evidence.quote: Clean, predictable, and fully documented REST APIs for every payment workflow.
We offer a sandbox environment with full API access at no cost. You can test transactions, webhooks, and integrations before going live.
Connect **Cursor**, **Claude Desktop**, **VS Code**, and other AI assistants to your Paygent account.
